title: RAG Chunk Metadata
description: Payload metadata attached to every vector stored in Qdrant. Enforces ABAC attribute presence at index time.

chunk_id.description: Unique identifier for this chunk within the document.

doc_id.description: Identifier of the source document this chunk belongs to.

title.description: Title of the source document, for display in citations.

text.description: The raw text content of the chunk.

owner.description: Resource owner or team responsible for this document.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp of the source document.
